hardening.minimized_reason: The HTTP client omits Brotli, Zstd, SOCKS and system-proxy support; gzip, deflate, HTTP/2, TLS and normal vault operation remain.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Vaultwarden for werewolf's vaultwarden form, as Wolfi would package it: built by melange in Wolfi's environment with Wolfi's Rust, linked to Wolfi's OpenSSL and SQLite, so their fixes reach a machine with the rest of its packages (howl unpacks it into the image and checks what it links: cmd/howl/melange.zig). cargo-auditable records its crates in the binary, for scanners. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
